verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: După aceea a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:

verses.geez: ናሁ ፡ ተሰመይኩ ፡ በስመ ፡ ቤስልኤል ፡ ዘውሬ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኦር ፡ ዘእምነገደ ፡ ይሁዳ ።
verses.translation: Behold, I have called by name Beseleel the son of Urias the son of Or, of the tribe of Juda.

translations.lxx: Behold, I have called by name Beseleel the son of Urias the son of Or, of the tribe of Juda.
translations.kjv: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
translations.ron: "Iată, Eu am rânduit anume pe Beţaleel, fiul lui Uri, fiul lui Or, din seminţia lui Iuda,

verses.geez: ወመላእክዎ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ ወጥበበ ፡ ወአእምሮ ፡ ወዕቁም ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምግባር ፡ ከመ ፡ የሐሊ ፤
verses.translation: And I have filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom, and understanding, and knowledge, to invent in every work,

translations.lxx: And I have filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom, and understanding, and knowledge, to invent in every work,
translations.kjv: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
translations.ron: Şi l-am umplut de duh dumnezeiesc, de înţelepciune, de pricepere, de ştiinţă şi de iscusinţă la tot lucrul,

verses.geez:
ወይኩን ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ጸረብት ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ወርቀ ፡ ወብሩረ ፡ ወብርተ ፡ ወዘሕብረ ፡ ያክንት ፡ ወሜላተ ፡ ወነተ ፡
                  ዘፍትሎ ፡ ወቢሶሰ ፡ ክዑበ ፤
verses.translation: and to frame works, to labour in gold, and silver, and brass, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet,

translations.lxx: and to frame works, to labour in gold, and silver, and brass, and blue, and purple, and spun scarlet,
translations.kjv: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
translations.ron: Ca să facă lucruri de aur, de argint şi de aramă, de mătase violetă, stacojie şi vişinie, şi de în răsucit,

verses.geez: ወግብረሂ ፡ እብን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምግባር ፡ ወዘይጸርብ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበር ፡ በውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምግባር ።
verses.translation: and works in stone, and for artificers' work in wood, to work at all works.

translations.lxx: and works in stone, and for artificers' work in wood, to work at all works.
translations.kjv: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
translations.ron: Să şlefuiască pietre scumpe pentru podoabe şi să sape în lemn tot felul de lucruri.

verses.geez:
ወአነ ፡ ወሀብኩ ፡ ኤልያብሃ ፡ ዘአኪሰምክ ፡ ዘእምሕዝበ ፡ ዳን ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ጠቢበ ፡ ልብ ፡ ወሀብኩ ፡ አእምሮ ፡
                  ወይግበሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአዘዝኩከ ፤
verses.translation: And I have appointed him and Eliab the son of Achisamach of the tribe of Dan, and to every one understanding in heart I have given understanding; and they shall make all things as many as I have appointed thee,—

translations.lxx: And I have appointed him and Eliab the son of Achisamach of the tribe of Dan, and to every one understanding in heart I have given understanding; and they shall make all things as many as I have appointed thee,—
translations.kjv: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
translations.ron: Şi iată, i-am dat ca ajutor pe Oholiab, fiul lui Ahisamac, din seminţia lui Dan, şi am pus înţelepciune în mintea oricărui om iscusit, ca să facă toate câte ţi-am poruncit:

verses.geez: ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡር ፡ ወታቦተ ፡ ዘሕርመት ፡ ወምኅዋ[ጸ] ፡ ዘላዕሌሃ ፡ ወንዋ[የ] ፡ ዘደብተራ ፤
verses.translation: the tabernacle of witness, and the ark of the covenant, and the propitiatory that is upon it, and the furniture of the tabernacle,

translations.lxx: the tabernacle of witness, and the ark of the covenant, and the propitiatory that is upon it, and the furniture of the tabernacle,
translations.kjv: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
translations.ron: Cortul adunării, chivotul legii, capacul cel de deasupra lui şi toate lucrurile cortului;

verses.geez: ወመሥዋዕተ ፡ ወማእደ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ንዋያ ፡ ወተቅዋመ ፡ ማኅቶት ፡ ንጽሕተ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ንዋያ ፤
verses.translation: and the altars, and the table and all its furniture,

translations.lxx: and the altars, and the table and all its furniture,
translations.kjv: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
translations.ron: Masa şi toate vasele ei; sfeşnicul cel de aur curat cu toate obiectele lui şi jertfelnicul tămâierii;

verses.translation: and the pure candlestick and all its furniture, and the laver and its base,

translations.lxx: and the pure candlestick and all its furniture, and the laver and its base,
translations.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
translations.ron: Jertfelnicul pentru arderile de tot cu toate obiectele lui; baia şi postamentul ei;

verses.geez: ወአልባሲሁ ፡ [ዘ]ግብሩ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ወአልባሰ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ በዘ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ግብረ ፡ ሊተ ፤
verses.translation: and Aaron's robes of ministry, and the robes of his sons to minister to me as priests,

translations.lxx: and Aaron's robes of ministry, and the robes of his sons to minister to me as priests,
translations.kjv: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,
translations.ron: ţesăturile pentru înveliş, veşmintele sfinţite pentru Aaron preotul şi veşmintele de slujbă pentru fiii lui;

verses.geez: ወቅብ[አ] ፡ ዘይቀብኡ ፡ ወዕጣ[ነ] ፡ ዘየዐጥኑ ፡ ለመቅደስ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘእኤዝዘከ ፡ ይግበሩ ።
verses.translation: and the anointing oil and the compound incense of the sanctuary; according to all that I have commanded thee shall they make them.

translations.lxx: and the anointing oil and the compound incense of the sanctuary; according to all that I have commanded thee shall they make them.
translations.kjv: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
translations.ron: Mirul pentru ungere şi aromatele mirositoare pentru locaşul cel sfânt; toate le vor face ei aşa, cum ti-am poruncit Eu ţie".

verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a mai vorbit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:

verses.geez:
ወአንተኒ ፡ አዝዞሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ ዑቁ ፡ ከመ ፡ [ትዕቀ]ቡ ፡ ሰንበትየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ትእምርት ፡
                  ውእቱ ፡ በኀቤየ ፡ ወበኀቤክሙኒ ፡ በትውልድክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታእምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘእቄድሰክሙ ።
verses.translation: Do thou also charge the children of Israel, saying, Take heed and keep my sabbaths; for they are a sign with me and among you throughout your generations, that ye may know that I am the Lord that sanctifies you.

translations.lxx: Do thou also charge the children of Israel, saying, Take heed and keep my sabbaths; for they are a sign with me and among you throughout your generations, that ye may know that I am the Lord that sanctifies you.
translations.kjv: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
translations.ron: "Spune fiilor lui Israel aşa: Băgaţi de seamă să păziţi zilele Mele de odihnă, căci acestea sunt semn între Mine şi voi din neam în neam, ca să ştiţi că Eu sunt Domnul, Cel ce vă sfinţeşte.

verses.geez:
ወዕቀቡ ፡ ሰንበትየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ወዘአርኰሳ ፡ ሞተ ፡ ለይሙት ፤ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይገብር ፡ ባቲ ፡
                  ግብረ ፡ ለይሰሮ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ እምሕዝባ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall keep the sabbaths, because this is holy to the Lord for you; he that profanes it shall surely be put to death: every one who shall do a work on it, that soul shall be destroyed from the midst of his people.

translations.lxx: And ye shall keep the sabbaths, because this is holy to the Lord for you; he that profanes it shall surely be put to death: every one who shall do a work on it, that soul shall be destroyed from the midst of his people.
translations.kjv: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
translations.ron: Păziţi deci ziua de odihnă, căci ea este sfântă pentru voi. Cel ce o va întina, acela va fi omorât; tot cel ce va face într-însa vreo lucrare, sufletul acela va fi stârpit din poporul Meu;

verses.geez:
ሰዱሰ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ግብረ ፡ ወበሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ሰንበተ ፡ ዕረፍት ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵሉ ፡
                  ዘይገብር ፡ ግብረ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሰንበት ፡ ሞተ ፡ እመዊት ፡ ይሙት ።
verses.translation: Six days thou shalt do works, but the seventh day is the sabbath, a holy rest to the Lord; every one who shall do a work on the seventh day shall be put to death.

translations.lxx: Six days thou shalt do works, but the seventh day is the sabbath, a holy rest to the Lord; every one who shall do a work on the seventh day shall be put to death.
translations.kjv: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
translations.ron: Şase zile să lucreze, iar ziua a şaptea este zi de odihnă, închinată Domnului; tot cel ce va munci în ziua odihnei va fi omorât.

verses.geez: ወይዕቀቡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሰናብተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበርዎን ፡ በዳሮሙ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel shall keep the sabbaths, to observe them throughout their generations.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel shall keep the sabbaths, to observe them throughout their generations.
translations.kjv: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
translations.ron: Să păzească deci fiii lui Israel ziua odihnei, prăznuind ziua odihnei din neam în neam, ca un legământ veşnic.

verses.geez:
ሥርዐት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ተአምር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡ እስመ ፡ በሰዱስ ፡ ዕለት
                  ፡ ገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ፡ ወበሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ፈጸመ ፡ ወአዕረፈ ።
verses.translation: It is a perpetual covenant with me and the children of Israel, it is a perpetual sign with me; for in six days the Lord made the heaven and the earth, and on the seventh day he ceased, and rested.

translations.lxx: It is a perpetual covenant with me and the children of Israel, it is a perpetual sign with me; for in six days the Lord made the heaven and the earth, and on the seventh day he ceased, and rested.
translations.kjv: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
translations.ron: Acesta este semn veşnic între Mine şi fiii lui Israel, pentru că în şase zile a făcut Domnul cerul şi pământul, iar în ziua a şaptea a încetat şi S-a odihnit".

verses.geez:
ወወሀቦ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ፈጸመ ፡ ተናግሮ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ በደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ጽላተ ፡ ዘትእዛዝ ፡ ጽላተ ፡
                  ዘእብን ፡ ጽሑፋት ፡ በአጽባዕት ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And he gave to Moses when he left off speaking to him in mount Sina the two tables of testimony, tables of stone written upon with the finger of God.

translations.lxx: And he gave to Moses when he left off speaking to him in mount Sina the two tables of testimony, tables of stone written upon with the finger of God.
translations.kjv: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
translations.ron: După ce a încetat Dumnezeu de a grăi cu Moise, pe Muntele Sinai, i-a dat cele două table ale legii, table de piatră, scrise cu degetul lui Dumnezeu.
